title: uses-recover
summary: Recovers the uses edges of units that ship without source, from the vendor's .hpp headers and a dcc map; read-only, never reads a .dcu
intro: Read this when a project uses a library shipped as compiled units only and you want to know what those units depend on. uses-recover lists every unit the index uses but has no source for, reads the interface uses from the C++Builder header the vendor ships beside it, follows the units those headers name, and, given a dcc map, says which of them the linker pulled in. Nothing is written and no .dcu is read.

help: uses edges of units with NO source in --db or any --library-db, from the vendor's C++Builder
.hpp headers (#include lines = interface uses; System/SysInit dropped; never reads a .dcu).
--hpp-dir is repeatable, not recursive, first hit wins; sourceless targets are followed.
--map: a dcc -GS/-GD map; in_map per unit, map_only = linked units no header reaches.
Read-only. json: units[{unit, reach direct|header, used_by, header, in_map, uses[{unit,
Exit 0 = reported (zero included); 2 = no --db/--hpp-dir, missing DB/dir/map; 3 = unknown flag.

questions.ask: What do the compiled-only library units this project uses depend on?
Which sourceless units does the linker actually pull in, and which does no header explain?
